description: Land Acquisition - Maharagama, Wellawaya D/S Division, Monaragala District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific lands for the Uma Oya Multipurpose Development Project. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land parcels with their boundaries and extents. The content focuses exclusively on land acquisition matters, which falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
